items.html: And with this you will understand what was said to you in the secret of the Gadlut of ZA through the entry of these Mochin: for at first there were only VAK, and they grew and he became nine Sefirot, and this is through the three Sefirot of the NHY of Ima that entered into him and he became nine Sefirot. And were it not that they are considered as from the body of ZA itself and flesh from his flesh, how could he grow by means of them? But since they are now not the flesh of Ima, but only the flesh of ZA, therefore ZA grew a real growth: for the first article (Perk) of the Netzach of Tevunah is mixed with the two articles of the Chesed of ZA and becomes the Chokhma of ZA. And the middle article of Netzach is mixed with the third article of Chesed and the first article of the Netzach of ZA, and becomes the Chesed of ZA. And the third article of the Netzach of Ima joins with the two lower articles of the Netzach of ZA, and becomes the Netzach of ZA. And in this same manner in the other two Sefirot, until he becomes literally a grown one of his own complete nine Sefirot.
